_comment: Pegged-currency groups. Each array in "groups" is one peg group whose currencies MAY be mixed
on a single QR payment request (e.g. dollar-pegged USD/USDC/USDT/FRNT). Currencies from two
different groups must not be combined (e.g. USD + BRL); any currency not listed in a group is
non-pegged and must be the only currency on the request.
FRNT is the Frontier Stable Token issued by the State of Wyoming: pegged to the US dollar and
redeemable at par, which is what puts it in the dollar group rather than merely near it. Being
in this file says two currencies may appear together; supported-currencies.json separately says
whether this deployment accepts either at all.
This '_comment' key is documentation only and is ignored by the loader, keeping the file strict,
